en: Psalms 9
For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David.

zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用慕拉便。

p.src: 1  I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

en: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
u.src: 1  I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

p.src: 2  I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

en: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
u.src: 2  I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

p.src: 3  When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

en: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
u.src: 3  When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

p.src: 4  For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

en: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
u.src: 4  For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

p.src: 5  You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

en: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
u.src: 5  You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

p.src: 6  The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

en: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
u.src: 6  The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

p.src: 7  But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

en: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
u.src: 7  But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

p.src: 8  He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

en: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
u.src: 8  He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

p.src: 9  The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

en: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
u.src: 9  The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

p.src: 10  Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

en: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
u.src: 10  Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

p.src: 11  Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

en: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
u.src: 11  Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

p.src: 12  For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

en: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
u.src: 12  For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

p.src: 13  Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

en: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
u.src: 13  Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

p.src: 14  that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

en: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
u.src: 14  that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

p.src: 15  The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

en: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
u.src: 15  The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

p.src: 16  The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

en: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.
u.src: 16  The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

zh: 9:16 或譯：他叫惡人被自己手所做的累住了

p.src: 17  The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

en: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
u.src: 17  The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

en: 9:17 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 18  For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
u.src: 18  For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

p.src: 19  Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

en: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
u.src: 19  Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

p.src: 20  Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

en: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
u.src: 20  Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
